personal_allowance_2024_2026.notes: Frozen at £12,570 until April 2028 per Autumn Budget 2022

ni_employee_rate_2024.notes: Reduced from 12% to 8% on 6 Jan 2024 (Spring Budget)

pension_annual_allowance_2024_2026.notes: Raised to £60,000 from April 2023, unchanged since

ssp_weekly_rate_2024_2025.notes: £116.75/week for 2024/25 and 2025/26; paid by employer for up to 28 weeks; self-employed not eligible

ni_lower_earnings_limit_2024.notes: £123/week in 2024/25; must earn at least this to qualify for SSP

income_protection_coverage_range.notes: ABI guidance: 50–70% of gross salary; no fixed premium benchmark as premiums vary by age, health, and occupation

life_insurance_salary_multiple.notes: 10× annual gross salary is the widely cited MoneyHelper / ABI rule of thumb; actual need depends on mortgage and dependants

employer_liability_minimum_cover.notes: Minimum £5 million cover required under Employers' Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969; most policies provide £10 million
